the plant proteome is highly dynamic in response to salinity and the changes in the proteome are associated with the changes in gene expression and protein posttranslitional modifications.

plant proteome response under salinity stress and the resulting changes at physiological level.

understanding the mechanisms of plant salt tolerance and with identification of the key players in plant response to salinity stress.

the salinity stress is an extremely complex and multifaceted stress factor, which is manifested by a wide range of physiological, biochemical, cellular and molecular changes.

salinity tolerance is a complex phenomenon and that it is unlikely to be achieved by a single mechanism.
